summary: Backend testing of Contract Management V2 flagship module. Created /app/backend/tests/test_contracts_v2.py with 25 pytest cases covering reference lists, CRUD, status lifecycle + audit trail, milestones and notices lifecycle with overdue/due counts, stats + project summary, templates roundtrip, live status derivation ('Expiring Soon' within 30 days AND overdue), global search by contractRef, Command Centre attention (contract_expiring, contract_notice_due, contract_milestone_overdue), cross-user isolation, invalid input 400s, unknown id 404s, and regression on the other V2 flagship tools (purchase-orders / invoice-builder / applications-for-payment / variation-orders) for their /reference and /stats endpoints. All 25 tests passed in 11.23s.

minor.issue: No history entry is appended when milestones/notices are updated or deleted (only POST-add appends history). Not blocking, but audit trail is incomplete for edits/deletes.

NOTICE_TYPES contains both 'Pay Less Notice' and 'Payless Notice' (duplicate concept, different spellings). Consider dedupe — spec asks for 14 notice types total, so this may be intentional but worth confirming.

action_items: Consider appending history entries on milestone/notice update and delete (currently only creation is logged). Non-blocking.
Confirm intent of both 'Pay Less Notice' and 'Payless Notice' entries in NOTICE_TYPES.
critical_code_review_comments: contracts.py is 740 lines and self-contained; large but organized. Could be split (reference / crud / lifecycle / attention) if it grows further.
_seq_ref uses find_one_and_update with $inc but does not set an upsert — depends on user doc already existing (safe in current auth flow).

Milestone/Notice update endpoints reuse the *In model as full-replacement payloads with exclude_none merge; this works but 'type' being required on NoticeIn means PATCH callers must always resend 'type'. Consider a NoticeUpdate model with all-optional fields to mirror ContractUpdate pattern.
History audit trail lacks entries for edits/deletes of milestones and notices — audit-trail claim in module docstring is partially incomplete.

rca of the issue: No issues to RCA — all requested features work as specified. Two minor observations flagged in backend_issues.minor above.
